I swallow whole the small animals I catch. Voles, shrews, mice, and even a few beetles. I don't chew them. I just swallow them whole, whole and whole. It's how I eat. I don't need to chew. I have a strong gizzard that grinds them up later. But I don't swallow the bones. I cough them up. That's how I get rid of them. I don't like bones. I prefer the meat.
